visual_review_scope: two temporal frames from each of two views per case; source clips retained
held_observation: hands remain around the target cup; no observed visual contradiction to held labels
topple_observation: visible leaning/tipping in selected frames; cups may be occluded or terminal video may precede exact60degree crossing
out_of_region_observation: cup placement offset is visible in multiple cases;25mm threshold is checked from raw XY, not inferred from pixels
